description_en: Queries the details of query execution on an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 本接口用于查看指定时间段的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版存储弹性模式实例的SQL执行信息
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-diagnosis-monitor-performance --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --database adbtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosisMonitorPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition on queries. Specify the value in the JSON format. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`: filters the top 100 queries that are the most time-consuming.

`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: filters completed queries.

`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`: filters running queries.

`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`: filters the queries that consume 30 milliseconds or more and less than 50 milliseconds. You can customize a filter condition by setting Min and Max.

    *   If only Min is specified, the queries that consume a period of time that is greater than or equal to the Min value are filtered.
    *   If only Max is specified, the queries that consume a period of time that is less than the Max value are filtered.
    *   If both Min and Max are specified, the queries that consume a period of time that is greater than or equal to the Min value and less than the Max value are filtered
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，JSON格式，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`：耗时最长的100个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：已完成的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`：运行中的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`：自定义耗时查询，您可以自定义设置查询的最短耗时和最长耗时，Min表示最短耗时；Max表示最长耗时，单位为毫秒（ms）。
    - 仅设置Min表示查询执行耗时大于该值的查询。
    - 仅设置Max表示查询执行耗时小于该值的查询。
    - 设置Min和Max表示查询耗时大于等于Min的值且小于等于Max的值的查询
parameters.name: query_condition

Cost.description_en: The execution duration of the query. Unit: milliseconds
Cost.description_zh: 查询运行的总时间，单位为毫秒（ms）

QueryID.description_en: The ID of the query. It is a unique identifier of the query
QueryID.description_zh: 查询ID，即查询的唯一标识

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间，为毫秒级UNIX时间戳

Status.description_en:
The execution state of the query. Valid values:

running: The query is being executed.
finished: The query is complete
Status.description_zh:
查询的执行状态，取值如下：

running：执行中。
finished：已完成

User.description_en: The name of the database account

PerformancesThreshold.description_en: The threshold for the number of queries

PerformancesTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the queries are truncated when the number of queries exceeds the threshold. Valid values:

true: The queries are truncated.
false: The queries are not truncated
PerformancesTruncated.description_zh:
查询数量是否截断，取值如下：

true：截断。
false：不截断
